item.title: Toy Storage in a Small Apartment: A Reachable, Rotating System
item.description: Quick answer: keep one low, anchored shelf with open bins at child height, keep only a small set of toys out, store the rest in a closed bin that rotates in, give soft toys and books their own home, and finish each day with a short reset the child can help with. Why Toys Take Over Small Apartments Toys arrive faster than they leave. Gifts, hand-me-downs, party favors and impulse purchases all add up, and in a small apartment every toy lives in the same rooms as the sofa, the dining table and the walkway.
